clips.title: The story
paras: The Stormwind Guard comprises the regional garrisons and sentries tasked with enforcing the kingdom's laws and defending its surrounding territories. Stretched perilously thin by political gridlock and distant military campaigns, its scattered marshals struggle to hold back gnolls, orcs, and bandits across Elwynn and Redridge.

Operating as a vital branch of the Stormwind Army, the Stormwind Guard patrols the highways, crossroads, and stone watchtowers that bind the kingdom together. In outlying settlements, governance and defense fall to appointed marshals—such as Marshal McBride in Northshire Valley, Marshal Dughan in Goldshire, and Marshal Marris in Lakeshire. These officers muster recruits and maintain order, relying on trusty brown horses known for stamina to cover ground between fortified outposts like Westbrook Garrison.
